name: FairTix Lottery Winner Notification System
businessNarrative: This workflow converts FairTix lottery selections into ticket sales by automatically notifying winners and directing them to complete purchases within 24 hours. FairTix operates an anti-bot ticketing platform with fair queue systems and transparent pricing (no hidden fees), positioning against traditional ticketing platforms like Ticketmaster. The system tracks notification delivery status, ensuring accountability in the sales conversion process. This automation is critical to FairTix's revenue model, as lottery winners who don't receive notifications won't complete purchases, directly impacting sales.
trigger: New lottery winner added to the LotteryWins spreadsheet
dataFlow: Lottery winner data (Name, Email, EventName, TicketPrice) flows from Google Sheets into personalized winner notification emails with checkout links. Email delivery status and timestamps flow back to the spreadsheet for tracking.

impact.reasoning: This directly generates revenue by converting lottery winners to buyers. Failed notifications mean lost sales with no recovery mechanism for that 24-hour window. Each winner represents confirmed ticket revenue that becomes unrecoverable if the notification fails.
impact.failureScenario: Lottery winners never receive notification emails, miss their 24-hour purchase window, tickets go unsold, direct revenue loss, customer complaints about unfair lottery process.
impact.revenueConnection: Direct - each successful notification converts to ticket sales within 24 hours. Failed notifications equal lost revenue. Data-driven.
